description:
This charming bungalow is ideally situated in a peaceful cul-de-sac location, just a stone's throw away from the city centre. The property features a generously sized living room and a dining kitchen, perfect for family gatherings or entertaining guests. With three spacious bedrooms and a modern bathroom, there is ample space for comfortable living.

Gardens at the front and rear offer a private outdoor space for relaxation or outdoor dining. Additional features include off-street parking, a garage with additional ample built in storage, and eco-friendly solar panels.

Located south of the city, off London Road, residents benefit from easy access to the city centre, M6, at Junction 42. The area is well-equipped with amenities such as supermarkets and food outlets. Don't miss out on this fantastic opportunity - schedule a viewing today.

Directions From Carlisle city centre, head south on London Road. Continue past St Nicholas retail park and London Road retail park. Turn left onto Hillcrest Avenue, continuing onto High Bank Close.

Services Mains gas, electric, water and drains are connected, but neither these services nor any boilers or radiators have been tested.
